result.title: Honesty Is a Race: Predicting When Verifiable-Reward RL Teaches a Model to Bluff
result.summary: Two rewards with the same expected payoff at the start of training can end a reinforcement-learning run in opposite places, with an honest model or one that bluffs. We study rewards that pay $b$ for a verdict that a checker cannot verify ("this program is correct") and $r$ for a certificate that it accepts (an input revealing a bug). To first order, a GRPO step makes the model more honest exactly when $\tilde{p}\,r/b>1+κ$. Here $\tilde{p}$ is the rate at which the checker accepts the model's certificates, weighted toward the items on which the model still gives both verdicts, and $κ$ is the pull of the items on which the unverifiable verdict is right. Both terms move during training. A checker raises $\tilde{p}$, so near the threshold honesty is a race, which a run just below the threshold can win and a run under a lottery (random pay with the same mean) cannot. The term $κ$ starts large and falls as the other items settle, so a run just above the threshold first dips toward bluffing, on code nearly to zero, before climbing back. Paying the honest verdict also pulls the other items toward it, which predicts a ceiling on the payoff ratio, above which the model gives the honest verdict where it is wrong. On propositional Datalog, two code models, and abstention on grade-school math, with $p$ the model's success rate before RL, no run above $pr/b=1$ ends collapsed, and runs under the checker can survive slightly below it. At $pr/b=3$, above the ceiling, both code models call about half of correct programs buggy. On depth-3 Datalog, training generously under the checker and then cutting the payoff keeps the model at least 67% honest in three seeds, at a ratio where the same model trained from the start falls to 4-15% and is at most 47% honest after 160 steps. On depth-2 Datalog, when honesty collapses, a linear probe fit before RL still reads the truth.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 GRPO 的一阶分析预测可验证奖励 RL 何时让模型走向诚实或虚报，并在 Datalog、代码与数学弃答任务上检验诚实阈值、收益上限和训练顺序效应；还发现诚实输出崩溃时线性探针仍能读出真实答案。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可验证奖励下的诚实/虚报阈值及「内部状态仍保留真相」的观察，可供核查 LVR 的奖励塑形、监督分配与潜状态信息坍缩问题，但研究对象为纯文本，迁移到视觉推理需自行验证。
